const { direction = 'left' } = {};
const left: 'left' = direction;
const { count = 1 } = {};
const one: 1 = count;
const { missing: { value = 3 } = {} } = {};
const three: 3 = value;
const [four = 4] = [];
const fourLit: 4 = four;
const property = 'fifth';
const { [property]: five = 5 } = {};
const fiveLit: 5 = five;
function choose(value: boolean) {
  return value ? { six: 6 as const } : {};
}
const { six = 0 } = choose(true);
const sixOrZero: 6 | 0 = six;
let { mutable = 7 } = {};
mutable = 8;
let assigned = 0;
({ assigned = 9 } = {});
console.log(left, one, three, fourLit, fiveLit, sixOrZero, mutable, assigned);
function undefinedDefault(flag: boolean) {
  const { result = flag ? 'on' : undefined } = {};
  const typed: 'on' | undefined = result;
  console.log(typed);
}
undefinedDefault(false);
for (const { value = 'seed' } of [{}]) {
  const seed:'seed' = value;
  console.log(seed);
}
function defaults({ one = 1, two = 2 } = { two: 4 }) {
  console.log(one, two);
}
defaults();
defaults({});
defaults({ one: 5 });
function listDefaults([first = 1, second = 2] = []) {
  console.log(first, second);
}
listDefaults();
listDefaults([3]);

{
  const {outer: {value} = {value: 1}} = {outer: {value: 2, extra: true}};
  const result: number = value;
  console.log(result);
}
{
  let {outer: {value} = {value: 3}} = {outer: {extra: true}};
  const result: number | undefined = value;
  console.log(result);
}
{
  const {outer: {value = 4} = {value: 5}} = {outer: {extra: true}};
  console.log(value);
}
function annotatedVariableDefault() {
  const {outer: {value} = {value: 6, extra: true}}: {outer?: {value: number; extra: boolean}} = {};
  return value;
}
console.log(annotatedVariableDefault());

function objectOrEmptyBranch(flag: boolean) {
  const {outer: {value} = {value: 1}} = flag ? {outer: {value: 2}} : {outer: {}};
  return value;
}
function objectOrMissingBranch(flag: boolean) {
  const {outer: {value} = {value: 1}} = flag ? {outer: {value: 2}} : {};
  return value;
}
console.log(objectOrEmptyBranch(true), objectOrEmptyBranch(false), objectOrMissingBranch(true), objectOrMissingBranch(false));
